Distribution. Nomewaimea urerana has been collected throughout much of the Koʻolau and Waiʻanae Ranges between elevations of ca. 500 – 1200 m. It is most common in wet forest and gulches, but can be occasionally found in more shaded, mesic areas wherever native Urticaceae grow.
